tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: What the maps contain, the price, imagery coverage and quality, how to pay over x402, and how a person can buy one directly. Free.

tools.name: check_map
tools.description: Lay out the map and report what it had to compromise on -- overlapping labels, truncated text, annotations off the page -- plus the imagery quality and what was drawn, so drafted labels can be edited. Returns no image. Free; iterate here before make_map.

tools.name: preview_map
tools.description: Render the map at screen size with a PREVIEW watermark and return it as an image, so the user can see the layout before buying. Same request as make_map. Free.

tools.name: make_map
tools.description: Render the print-resolution map and return a download link. Costs $1 USDC, paid over x402: the first call returns the payment requirements; sign and call again with the payment. Charged only if the render succeeds. Includes 7 days of free revisions via revise_map.

tools.name: revise_map
tools.description: Re-export a map bought with make_map, free for 7 days: change labels, annotations, styling, overlays or page elements. The frame must stay the same -- address or center, groundWidthM, pageSize, orientation, dpi. Requires the mapId make_map returned.
